name: SidebarProvider
description:
Holds one sidebar's state (expanded, phone sheet, width, groups and shortcut) and lays its
Sidebar and SidebarInset out side by side, filling the container.
signature: ({ open, defaultOpen, onOpenChange, openMobile, onOpenMobileChange, shortcut, storageKey, mobileQuery, name, nonce, className, children, ...rest }: SidebarProviderProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the desktop sidebar starts expanded when uncontrolled and nothing is remembered.

props.name: mobileQuery
props.description: Below this media query the sidebar becomes a sheet from its edge.

props.name: name
props.description: Names this provider so a SidebarTrigger or `useSidebar(name)` inside a nested provider can reach it.

props.name: nonce
props.description: Content-Security-Policy nonce for the inline boot script rendered during server rendering.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description:
Called with the next desktop state and why it changed (a trigger, the shortcut, the
Rail, a drag past the minimum width). Update controlled state here.

props.name: onOpenMobileChange
props.description: Called with the next phone sheet state and why: a trigger, a destination chosen in it, or swipe, Esc or the scrim.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the desktop sidebar is expanded (controlled). Pair with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: openMobile
props.description: Whether the phone sheet is open (controlled). Pair with `onOpenMobileChange`.

props.name: shortcut
props.description:
The keys that toggle the sidebar from anywhere on the page, or `false` for none. The
default is `"mod+b"` (⌘B, Ctrl+B) for a start sidebar and none for an end one. It is
ignored while focus is in rich text or a custom text box, where Ctrl+B means bold.
Triggers show it in their tooltips and `aria-keyshortcuts`.

props.name: storageKey
props.description:
Remember the open state, the dragged width and the open groups under this localStorage
key, so they survive a reload without a flash. Inside a storage scope (a window body) the
scope is appended. Absent: nothing persists.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
